description: Test of the ops log's write side (log plan stage L1b): a card door, a sign-in PC and a game clock, with log sources declared and no reader yet. Copy a badge, swipe in, fail the sign-in, sign in, lock the screen. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove the server writes a log row for each badge swipe, sign-in outcome and session end or lock as the plan's table gives it, into the declared sources only, with the game clock's time and no secret in any row
